def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marked = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if 9 in row]
    if min(marked) < h // 2:
        end = max(marked) + 2
        block = [row[:] for row in grid[:end]]
        at_top = True
    else:
        start = min(marked) - 1
        block = [row[:] for row in grid[start:]]
        at_top = False
    markers = {
        j for j in range(w)
        if sum(row[j] == 9 for row in block) == 1
        and all(row[j] == 7 for row in block if row[j] != 9)
    }
    out = [[7] * w for _ in range(h)]
    n = len(block)
    if at_top:
        out[0] = [9 if j in markers else 7 for j in range(w)]
        out[h - n:] = block
    else:
        out[:n] = block
        out[-1] = [9 if j in markers else 7 for j in range(w)]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[7 if cell == 0 else cell for cell in row] for row in grid]
    marked = [(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] == 9]
    vertical = len({i for i, j in marked}) > 1 and len({j for i, j in marked}) > 2
    if vertical:
        rows = [i for i, j in marked]
        top = min(rows) < h // 2
        start, end = (0, max(rows) + 2) if top else (min(rows) - 1, h)
        n = end - start
        dst = h - n if top else 0
        for k in range(n):
            out[dst + k] = grid[start + k][:]
    else:
        cols = [j for i, j in marked]
        left = min(cols) < w // 2
        start, end = (0, 3) if left else (w - 3, w)
        n = end - start
        dst = w - n if left else 0
        for i in range(h):
            out[i][dst:dst + n] = grid[i][start:end]
    return out
